description.value:
Rank 1 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 12 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Light or Finesse Melee Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Weapon's Range
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

You make a flurrious storm of strikes against a target in range. Roll 3 Combo Attack Rolls dealing your Weapon Damage Die on a hit.

system.requirements: 1 *Light or Finesse Melee Weapon* that you are proficient with.
